sentences.text: But it was his ambitious proposal to bring together regional rivals India and China, alongside Nepal, to tackle these shared threats that drew particular attention.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: Shah called for the creation of a Himalayan Climate Resilience Mechanism to strengthen cross-border disaster response and the sharing of scientific data and expertise in one of the world's most environmentally fragile and geopolitically sensitive regions.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: "Let the Himalayas become a laboratory of international co-operation rather than a frontier of fragmented information," he said.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: A senior official at Nepal's foreign ministry, speaking on condition of anonymity, said the proposal was still at an early stage.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: "The PM's proposal has given a political direction.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: Our ministry is working with other relevant agencies to put forward a preliminary framework which can be the basis for building common understanding," the official said.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: Neither India nor China has formally responded to the proposal.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: The BBC has contacted their foreign ministries for comment.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: But can Nepal really bring the two regional giants together to confront a shared climate threat in a region where they have long been locked in bitter territorial disputes?
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: India and China share a disputed frontier stretching roughly 3,500km (2,175 miles), much of it across the Himalayas.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: Their competing territorial claims have led to a war, deadly clashes and repeated military stand-offs along the Line of Actual Control (LAC), the de facto boundary separating areas under their control.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: But the mountains that have long been a source of friction between the two countries are also facing an urgent climate threat.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: Temperatures in the Himalayan region are rising faster than the global average, accelerating glacier retreat and permafrost thaw and contributing to growing risks of landslides, rockfalls, avalanches and glacial lake outburst floods.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: Such disasters can sweep across national boundaries, threatening lives, infrastructure and livelihoods far downstream - making co-operation between the countries sharing the Himalayas increasingly important.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: Further east, on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, glaciers have shrunk by 24% in area over the past six decades, Kang Shichang, director of the Chinese Academy of Sciences' Institute of Mountain Hazards and Environment, told China's People's Daily Online.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: Experts say the retreat of glaciers can cause glacial lakes to expand, increasing the risk of sudden, potentially devastating floods that can cross borders into countries such as Nepal, India and Bhutan.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: Several major rivers flowing through these countries originate on the Tibetan Plateau.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: The plateau now has more than 14,000 glacial lakes, covering over 1,100 sq km, according to People's Daily.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: And the dangers extend beyond flooding.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: A 2024 study published by the American Geophysical Union projected a significant rise in landslide hazards across the Himalayas and Tibet in the coming decades due to increased rainstorms.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: While the largest absolute increases are expected in already vulnerable areas, including India's Garhwal and Kumaon regions and Nepal, the greatest relative increase is projected on the Tibetan Plateau.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: The growing risks make co-operation more urgent.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: But past efforts by India and China to work together on Himalayan environmental issues have made little progress.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: The two Asian powers have often found common ground at UN climate negotiations, pushing back against Western demands for emissions cuts and arguing that developing countries should not bear the same burden as industrialised nations.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: Yet they have no dedicated agreement to jointly address the impacts of climate change in the Himalayas.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: In 2009, India and China agreed to undertake joint research into the impact of global warming on glaciers in the Himalayas and Tibet.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: Following a visit to Beijing, India's then environment minister Jairam Ramesh announced that the Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology and China's Cold and Arid Regions Environmental and Engineering Research Institute would collaborate on the project.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: Hundreds of people were killed in the deadly flood that tore through the China-Nepal border in August But the initiative went nowhere, according to a scientist involved in the effort.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: "One meeting was held between us and the Chinese side and that was it, nothing came out of it," said Dr DP Dobhal, a retired glaciologist who headed the glaciology programme at the Wadia Institute.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: "What happened after that no one knows," he added.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: Since the early 2000s, India and China had agreements under which Beijing provided flood-season hydrological data on the Brahmaputra and Sutlej, two major rivers originating in Tibet.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: But in August 2025, India's junior foreign minister Kirti Vardhan Singh told parliament that both agreements had expired.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: China had stopped sharing data on the Brahmaputra in June 2023, while India had received no data on the Sutlej since 2022.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: China has not publicly explained the latest interruption.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: But when it withheld similar information in 2017, amid a tense military stand-off with India, Beijing blamed technical problems at its hydrological monitoring stations in Tibet, Singh said.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: Some analysts see a glimmer of hope in the recent thaw between India and China, marked by high-level political engagement and moves to revive cross-border trade through Himalayan routes.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: "These developments suggest there might be more room for the three countries to explore climate-related co-operation," says William Yang, senior analyst for North East Asia at the International Crisis Group.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: But he says Beijing is likely to remain cautious about any major agreement with India and Nepal, as border disputes remain unresolved.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: One major obstacle is that information vital for understanding climate risks can also have military value.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: Experts have raised concerns over climate-related risks as the Himalayan snow cover melts rapidly Such tensions have also hampered past efforts to tackle disasters that cross Himalayan borders.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: The Kathmandu-based International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development (ICIMOD) has spent more than three decades promoting regional co-operation, including on flood early-warning systems.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: But progress has been slow.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: "There are certain highly sensitive issues in transboundary matters like comprehensive data of river flows that countries might not want to share, particularly upstream countries," says Arun Bhakta Shrestha, a former senior specialist at ICIMOD.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: He says countries should instead focus on sharing less sensitive information about disaster risks.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: "Climate change is moving the baseline itself; catching up with the previous disaster is no longer enough.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: We need to anticipate the next one," he says.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: Whether India and China are willing to take even these steps remains uncertain.
sentences.article_title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats

sentences.text: For Nepal, the challenge is to convince its two powerful neighbours to put aside their differences and work together to tackle a shared climate threat.

sentences.text: Marine ecology dog Sgiath at work A working dog from the Scottish Highlands has been named animal of the year by a charity for hunting down an invasive marine creature called the carpet sea squirt.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: This organism, also nicknamed "sea vomit", is particularly harmful to coastal wildlife and economies.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: Working at low tide with her owner, Dr Texa Sim, black Labrador Sgiath has found hundreds of colonies of the sea squirt, which - if left uncontrolled - can smother and kill native species.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: Sgiath (pronounced Skee-ah) is thought to be the UK's first sea squirt-hunting dog.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: Carpet sea squirt can be tricky to spot among seaweed "She's a natural," says Sim proudly.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: The International Fund for Animal Welfare (IFAW) , external is awarding Sgiath animal of the years at its 26th annual animal Action Awards ceremony on Thursday 15 October.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: Sim, a marine ecologist based near Glencoe, has had Sgiath since she was a puppy and the bond between the two is strong.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: "Sgiath is incredibly clever.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: Her problem solving and her ability to take on new challenges and learn so quickly are just phenomenal, and it's so amazing to watch." As a pup, Sgiath was trained as a mountain rescue dog.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: The Labrador proved to be so good that Sim wondered if she could use her skills to help with marine conservation work.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: Sgiath has been trained to recognise the scent of the carpet sea squirt.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: And now, the six year old joins her owner on the beaches to sniff it out.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: Sim says the dog is always right when pointing out a sea squirt, which can be difficult to spot, looking like slime among seaweed and on structures like pontoons and oyster cages.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: Carpet sea squirt, or sea vomit, has spread to several places around the UK "When I first started this project, I genuinely didn't know whether it would work," said Sim.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: "No one had really explored whether dogs could help tackle this problem in the marine environment.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: It began as a proof-of-concept project and has exceeded every expectation I had." Dogs' scent detection skills are often used in conservation work on land, including tracking endangered species and helping investigate environmental crime.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: At low tide, Sgiath can, as Sim puts it "dive down under the seaweed".
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: "She just does a survey with her nose, essentially, she can pinpoint exactly where it is, so it's much easier," she said.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: Marine experts believe that carpet sea squirt, formally named Didemnum vexillum, came from Japan.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: It arrived on the shores of the south of England and Wales in 2008.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: It can appear in various shades - from orange to cream -  and has now spread to several seaside locations across the UK.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: It reproduces quickly during the warmer summer months and, with warming seas, there are fears it could spread further.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: Dr Martyn Kurr, a marine biologist from Bangor University told BBC News that non-native or "biofouling" species, like the carpet sea squirt, can outcompete native wildlife for valuable nutrients.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: "These species also clog up aquaculture pens, marine infrastructure, and machinery such as boat propellors," he explained.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: Efforts to control and clean up these problematic marine invaders costs millions of pounds every year across Europe.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: Sgiath is also a trained mountain rescue dog To get Sgiarth proficient in both mountain rescue and marine conservation has needed hard work and long hours from both dog and owner.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: To locate and draw attention to a lost hiker on mountainous terrain, Sgiath is trained to bark and bounce around.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: Conservation work requires a quieter approach.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: Sim explained that she trains Sgiath to give what's known as a "passive indication" when she finds the sea squirt.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: "It's a kind of a stillness, or a stare." Sgiath has been trained to stare when she finds carpet sea squirt When we speak to Sim over Zoom from her home, her two dogs are curled up in their beds at her feet.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: Apparently, when Sgiath is not out finding lost people or marine creatures, she likes to be wrapped up in her dog blanket.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: Sgiath, and Sim's younger Labrador Uisage, are both working dogs that are driven to do their jobs with treats and play.
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: Kurr, from Bangor University, said that scientists were just starting to realise that "these wonderful animals can smell changes in water that signal a marine invasion which otherwise might have gone unnoticed".
sentences.article_title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year

sentences.text: He added: "It's fantastic to see Sgiath get this much deserved award, and I'm very excited to see what other wonderful work we can do with sniffer dogs."

sentences.text: UK smartphone users could benefit from new payment, ticket and travel apps if Apple widens access to its contactless payment tech, the competition watchdog says.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: The Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) also wants the fees Apple charges firms to use its contactless tech to be "substantially lower".
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: It believes the iPhone maker's current fees and charges are "blocking" financial technology firms and others from innovating and growing - and is consulting on proposals it believes would cause these fees to fall.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: Apple maintains that widening access could undermine security, and that its current arrangements do not stop innovation.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: Nearly 2 in 5 payments are now contactless, the watchdog said, with nearly 60% of people using digital wallets - with Apple's the most popular in the UK.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: In a statement Apple told the BBC that the current arrangements had permitted developers in the UK and around the world to securely offer contactless transactions directly within their apps, for everything from in-store payments and transit passes to car keys and event tickets.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: "This solution enables developers and banks to create innovative products and services for their customers and facilitates competition between wallets, while ensuring users' sensitive data remains protected by the highest security standards".
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: "We do not believe the CMA should require Apple to adopt an approach with lower privacy and security protections.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: We will continue to engage constructively to reach an outcome that is in the best interest of our users." Last year Apple warned UK regulators against following the same path as the EU which forced it to open up a range of its technologies to rivals.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: However, the CMA argued that, unlike the EU, it is focused on ensuring the interoperability of particular aspects of Apple's tech, such as digital wallets and watches.

sentences.text: The group action focused on Uber's operations in London between May 2012 and March 2018 Uber has won its bid to throw out claims worth about £340m brought by thousands of London black cab drivers and two former private hire firms.

sentences.text: Christina Applegate thought she was living with multiple sclerosis (MS) for five years, until recently discovering she had been given a wrong diagnosis.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: The actress, known for hits like Anchorman and Married With Children, said she was "not happy at all" about the news and in tears when she found out.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: "You don't get misdiagnosed and then all of the sudden I'm better," Applegate said  in an episode of her Messy podcast released on Tuesday.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: "If anything, I've gotten worse." The two-part episode, co-hosted by Jamie Sigler, ends a recent break she took to process the information.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: An investigation into what has been causing her debilitating symptoms - which she experiences daily - will begin next week.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: "I'm back at square one where I don't know what's going on with me," she said.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: In the podcast, Applegate said that "all of a sudden, a few years ago", her doctor suggested ending her infusion treatment for MS to see how her body reacted.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: During the time off, her body did not respond in a way that would indicate she had MS.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: Doctors then looked into her case further and concluded she did not have the autoimmune disease, which can cause muscle stiffness and problems with walking and talking.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: "She came into my room and said, 'Congratulations, you don't have MS,' " Applegate said, recalling the moment.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: "I was, like, not happy at all," she continued.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: "Everybody else was so happy." Misdiagnoses can be extremely distressing for people dealing with chronic illnesses, said Dr Michael Kornberg.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: "It becomes part of your identity," the associate professor of neurology at Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine said, noting how there is a "comfort" in knowing what is happening inside your body.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: "It's not like we have something like a pregnancy test that says 'yes, you have it.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: No, you don't,'" Kaisey said.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: "It's a list of criteria." About 15 to 20 percent of patients diagnosed with MS do not actually have the disease, research suggests, according to Elena Grebenciucova, a neuroimmunology physician at Northwestern Medicine in Chicago.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: Dr Grebenciucova said the illness is typically diagnosed by finding a number of lesions - or white matter spots - with an MRI of the brain or spinal cord.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: But she said those white matter spots can sometimes be signs of different health problems or illnesses, like migraines, high blood pressure, high blood sugar and high cholesterol.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: The neurology doctor said another health condition, a vitamin B12 deficiency, can also lead to neurological problems that closely mirror MS symptoms, including cognitive decline, tingling and balance issues.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: MS is a diagnosis of exclusion, with doctors combing through a patient's medical history and many laboratory tests to make a determination, explained Dr Philip De Jager, the director of the Multiple Sclerosis Center at Columbia University Vagelos College of Physicians and Surgeons.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: Because misdiagnoses can happen, Dr De Jager said that patients should seek second opinions.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: Applegate was first diagnosed with MS in August 2021, after experiencing symptoms for a while, saying at the time: "It's been a tough road.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: But as we all know, the road keeps on going." Years later, she described being in a " real depression " and said in a 2024 episode of her podcast that "I don't enjoy living.
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: I don't enjoy things anymore".
sentences.article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongly diagnosed with MS

sentences.text: She had said in a New York Times interview that she could not walk without a cane and used a wheelchair during filming of the Netflix series Dead To Me.

sentences.text: Amid drumming and dancing, Boateng Bismark James leads 13 worshippers, nine men and four women, in prayer for drivers and passengers travelling to destinations across Ghana.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Ghana is a predominantly Christian country where preaching on public transport is widespread.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: On long-distance buses, pastors can often be seen - and heard - preaching the gospel.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Sometimes they stand in the stairwell next to the driver, at others they walk up and down the aisle reading from the Bible and calling on sinners to repent at the tops of their voices.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: They do not stop even if the trip lasts for several hours.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: The faithful sometimes offer money to the preachers to support their endeavours.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: But a new law means this familiar practice could be coming to an end.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Anyone found preaching in public service vehicles faces up to eight months in prison, a fine of up to $52 (£39) or both.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: The new regulation, passed by parliament in May, and which has started to be enforced in recent weeks, targets preaching and hawking on vehicles while they are in motion, classifying both as a nuisance and citing the safety and comfort of passengers.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Boateng, a 61-year-old pastor at Gospel Light church, has been preaching on commercial vehicles leaving Neoplan station since 2023.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "I preach on commercial vehicles because not everyone is able to go to church on Sunday.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: There are a lot of passengers who need our message of salvation to repent from their sins.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: We even heal the sick on some buses," he told the BBC in Twi, a local language.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Wearing a clerical collared shirt, Boateng moves through rows of buses loading passengers before boarding one bound for Kumasi, Ghana's second-largest city.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: We speak to him before the bus departs to avoid breaking the law.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Some travellers listen closely as he delivers his message.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Others try to ignore him, browsing their phones, making calls or chatting among themselves.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "Some passengers are very happy with my message.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Some even say they have never heard the message in church, but through my preaching they now know it is in the Bible," he says.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Boateng Bismark James and his group start preaching at the bus station before boarding the vehicles The new rules have divided opinion.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Critics say preaching on moving vehicles is a nuisance and a safety risk, as it could distract the driver, while supporters argue that evangelism is a Christian duty and should be protected under the freedom of religious worship.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: One woman in her early 30s, who wishes to be identified as Chery Lokko, says she prefers to travel in peace. ''I don't like it because they are a nuisance.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Some of them spit saliva on you unconsciously, especially if you are seated not far from them, and they are a nuisance in terms of noise and saliva.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: I like my peace whenever I'm on public transport.'' In one video widely shared on social media recently, a passenger on a minibus is seen angrily confronting a pastor attempting to board.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "Get down, I say get down," he shouts.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: But in this devout country, ranked among the most religious in the world , external , others say evangelism on public transport is an important way of reaching people who may not attend church.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Bernice Nartey, a passenger travelling to Kumasi, says pastors should be allowed to preach, but only with passengers' consent.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "The preaching sometimes helps people to repent.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: For instance, if someone is going through a stressful situation, the message of the pastor can give the person renewed hope," she says.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Boateng says he was shaken by the regulation and wants religious preachers to be given an exemption.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "We are very worried, because most pastors here depend on preaching to take care of their families through the monetary gifts offered by passengers," he says.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "The government should allow us to preach on the buses and alight when it is exiting Accra," he adds.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: For Boateng, preaching is not only a religious calling but also an important source of income.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "I have been able to take care of my children's education.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Preaching on commercial buses was first prohibited in Ghana in 2012, with offenders facing up to 30 days in prison.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: But enforcement was weak and so the practice remained common, particularly on buses.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: The new law beefs up the penalties for those that flout the ban.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Preachers using megaphones can also often be seen and heard at Ghana's lorry parks and markets but they are not affected by the ban.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: The Christian Council of Ghana did not respond to the BBC's request for a comment but Rev Enoch Paul Hayes, a senior pastor at one of the biggest churches in Ghana, the International Central Gospel Church, tells the BBC he does not think the new rules infringe on religious freedom.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: He urges his fellow pastors not to break the law, saying they should find other ways of spreading their message.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "There is social media as an alternative outlet, where the same message can reach thousands of people," he says.

sentences.text: Kgomotso Mathekga says a lack of male role models is fuelling violence against women in his neighbourhood "I witness men hitting women all the time," says Kgomotso Mathekga, 30.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "Especially when they are both drunk." "I once had an argument with my girlfriend," he admits, "and I grabbed and slapped her." Mathekga is speaking frankly during a gathering of men aimed at helping reduce the high levels of violence against women in South Africa.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: The meeting is held in a narrow street in a Johannesburg informal settlement known as Organic Market.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: It is a maze of corrugated metal shacks and unpaved roads, close to Alexandra township.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "Now I feel pain," Mathekga continues.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We broke up and I no longer see my child.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: I feel like I've contributed to the problems in South Africa, instead of being the gentleman that I know I am." At a nearby tavern, a group of men have pulled their chairs into a circle in the dust.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: At the centre stands Itumeleng Stephen Tamaga, known locally as Bra Steve.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: The group clap and cheers.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "Listen guys," Bra Steve says.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We must stand together to fight against gender-based violence and femicide." Bra Steve is the local organiser of Father A Nation, a non-profit that works with men and boys to promote positive masculinity and help end violence against women.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: The group's meeting comes as South Africa grapples with renewed anger over renewed cases of femicide and violence against women.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: The discovery of the bodies of 12 women over three months, in the city of Ekurhuleni, near Johannesburg has reignited questions about the scale of what many people see as being a crisis of violence against women.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Bra Steve says: "We must restore dignity to the men around here" South Africa's President Cyril Ramaphosa has acknowledged that his government has not done enough and announced measures he hopes can make women feel safer.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: The country has one of the highest murder rates in the world, with 5,427 people murdered between April and June this year alone.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: In that period, according to the South African Human Rights Commission, 569 women were killed, an average of six a day, and 1,052 others survived attempted murder.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: A report in 2022 by the Human Sciences Research Council found that more than 35% of South African women experienced physical or sexual violence, many from their own intimate partners.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: For Bra Steve, part of the solution to the crisis is helping men to understand the issue and take responsibility for their actions.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We are a lost generation," he says.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We must restore dignity to the men around here." Amongst the group of men outside the tavern is Zizipho Mtwesi, the project co-ordinator of Father A Nation.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Reflecting on recent weeks, he says more should be done.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: The latest measures announced by Ramaphosa, including better street lighting and a review of unsolved cases , are too little, he says, and too late.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "When I think about all of these recent murders in Johannesburg, I get angry.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Why do we have to wait for this to happen for us to act?" He looks around and gestures at the meeting.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We are trying to reach men before things like these murders happen again." Craig Wilkinson tells the group to "choose what kind of man you want to be" Craig Wilkinson is the founder of the group.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We get men to talk, to process their feelings," he explains.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "And as they do, this healing takes place.
